name: malga-integration-toolkit
description: Malga full-product integration toolkit. Covers online checkout (Charges API, Sessions, SDKs), payment links, VTEX, tokenization (PCI Hosted Fields), smart flows (orchestration), 3DS2, antifraud, split payments, recurrence/subscriptions, webhooks, and analytics. Hybrid architecture: 14 skills provide stable integration intelligence; .mcp.json scaffolds live API access for a future Malga MCP server.
